description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling 'DeleteConnection' commands within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging persistence framework. It constructs a delete event, prepares a response, and specifies a sequence of connection actions to execute.

classes.name: DeleteConnectionStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class implementing the handling of DeleteConnection commands within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity framework. It constructs appropriate events, responses, and determines the sequence of connection actions upon a delete command.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Processes the delete connection command by creating a ConnectionDeleted event, a delete response, and specifying the actions to perform, then returns the result encapsulating these.
